name: ClientFilingDeadlineTracker
tagline: Every statutory filing for every client entity and jurisdiction – one compliance calendar.
description: A complete compliance-calendar app for accounting, tax and corporate-secretarial firms: annual returns, accounts, corporate tax and GST/VAT/BAS filings across client entities and jurisdictions with due and extended dates, overdue and due-soon alerts, independent review, filing references, authority rejections, extension limits, penalty exposure and automatic roll-forward to the next period.
features: 8 KPI tiles incl. on-time rate and penalty exposure
Allowed status transitions with independent review
Record filing with date and acknowledgement reference
Extensions with type and day limits
Automatic roll-forward of annual, quarterly and monthly filings
Bulk status, assign, extension and roll-forward
Undo, activity log, demo mode, phone layout
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: ClientFilingDeadlineTracker data-set + ClientFilingDeadlineTrackerPortal field control, shared src/app)
